content.rendered:
If your student was absent for picture day or you would like a new photo, Dorian Studios will be taking picture retakes at Middleton on November 15th.  Online orders may be placed at Dorian Studios and selecting the green order button next to our school retake day.  Online orders are available up to 4 days after the retake day.  If you already ordered and want a new picture taken please return your original picture packet to the photographer on retake day. 

If you placed an order on-line for the original picture day, but your student was absent, you do not need to place another order.
